t: Donnan Equilibrium - an overview | ScienceDirect Topics
s: The Donnan equilibrium model was initially developed to govern the uneven distribution of ions between two sides of a membrane (Donnan and Harris, 1911) and later applied to pulp suspensions to simulate the adsorption equilibrium (Towers and Scallan, 1996).
